aesthetic.texture: fine paper-grain texture, gentle film grain, deep shadows
aesthetic.light: warm late-afternoon light through office blinds, horizontal slats casting soft striped shadows
aesthetic.palette: ink-on-bone palette, muted ox-blood accent, no saturated colors
aesthetic.motion: slow, restrained, observational; no quick cuts, no zooms past 5 percent
aesthetic.camera: 85mm lens feel, shallow depth of field, locked-off or 1cm dolly only
aesthetic.framing: human-eye level, off-center subject, generous negative space

prompts.subject: an actuary at a wood-trimmed desk, mid-30s, sleeves rolled, half-turned toward a paper print of a SERFF rate filing on the desk
prompts.numbers: the camera slowly settles on a single column of figures on the page: $442.80 quote, 0.873 trend factor, 6/6 regression
prompts.prompt:
Cinematic documentary-style background footage of a quiet office desk. On the desk: a printed insurance rate filing on cream paper, a fountain pen resting beside it, a leather-bound notebook open to a page of handwritten figures, a stoneware coffee cup. No people are visible in the frame.

Lighting is warm late-afternoon sun through office blinds. Horizontal slats cast soft striped shadows across the desk and the paper. Fine paper-grain texture, gentle film grain, deep shadows. Color palette is ink on bone, muted oxblood accent on the notebook ribbon, no saturated colors.

Motion is slow, restrained, observational. The camera barely moves, at most a one-centimeter dolly forward. The striped shadows drift almost imperceptibly as if the sun is setting. Shallow depth of field, 85mm lens feel. Eye level with the desk surface. The frame reads as a still from a working-paper documentary, not a software product ad.

No people, no faces, no hands. No text overlays. No logos. No abstract particles, no neon colors, no fast cuts.
